As of now, I'm taking Tuesday planning to help her get her burnt car towed back to Grand junction, get her and the kids a rental car, and anything else I might be able to help her with. 

I've been trying to stay consistent with being open, and I really am sorry to close.

✔️Found a bull we have been looking for and got him through a gate with some other cows.

✔️Caught a group of cows that were on the wrong side of a fence where a gate was left open.

✔️Put out salt.

✔️Checked water sources, including ponds and tanks.

✔️Never tightened the cinch and stepped in the saddle.

✔️A lot of bumpy miles in a side x side.

We took horses to the mountain, in case we needed them.

In the past, it would have taken someone 3-5 days to make the circle we made today. Checking water, distributing salt, checking health and well-being, looking at feed resources, fixing a hole in a fence, just being on the landacape and monitoring all of it.

It would have been done on a horse, today we made the miles on an ATV, with the horses on stand by, if needed. 

It was a good day.
